name: @mls/data-api
description: Meridian Launch Systems serving layer (L7): the REST API both frontends' ApiProvider already expects — GET /tables/:table for the ten generator tables and GET /feeds/:name for the six control-tower feeds. LOCAL backends read data/generated + committed fixtures (test harness); CLOUD backends read Azure SQL, the Fabric lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint and the live GitHub / Defender / Log Analytics APIs via managed identity.
